description: Get which airlines can be booked (award flights) using a specific airline loyalty program's miles. Use when asked "which airlines can I book with United miles?" or "can I use Aeroplan for Lufthansa?". Distinct from transfer partners — this is about redemption.

allianceFilter.description: Optional: filter bookable partners by alliance

programName.description: Airline loyalty program name (e.g., "United MileagePlus", "Aeroplan", "Flying Blue")

name: get_bookable_partners
